sources: Colorado state and local government job boards

Professional.label: Professional
Professional.prompt: Search for current non-game professional jobs for me. Focus on Project Manager, Project Coordinator, Implementation, Program, Operations, Training/Enablement, and adjacent leadership/coordination roles where my existing experience gives me a realistic chance of passing the initial resume screen. Exclude video game and 3D art roles. Prioritize fit over salary, with remote roles and Fort Collins/Colorado opportunities. Search LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed, Google Jobs/general web search, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Built In, Wellfound, USAJOBS, Colorado state/local government job boards, and direct employer career pages. Verify postings are live, give direct application links, and add strong matches to Raven with Track=Professional.

Labor.label: Labor
Labor.prompt: Search for current non-game labor and hands-on jobs for me around Fort Collins, Colorado, plus strong nearby options. Prioritize full-time work I could realistically start without a new degree or long certification path, including maintenance, facilities, parks/trails, pressure washing, painting, warehouse, production, field service, and similar hands-on roles. Search LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed, Google Jobs/general web search, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Built In, USAJOBS, Colorado state/local government job boards, and direct employer career pages. Verify postings are live, give direct application links, and add strong matches to Raven with Track=Labor.

Wildcard.label: Wildcard
Wildcard.prompt: Search for current non-game wildcard jobs I may be overlooking. Use my leadership, mentoring, project delivery, troubleshooting, training, maintenance, creative-production, and cross-functional experience to find realistic roles outside my obvious career paths. Include remote and Fort Collins/Colorado opportunities. Search LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed, Google Jobs/general web search, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Built In, Wellfound, USAJOBS, Colorado state/local government job boards, and direct employer career pages. Verify postings are live, give direct application links, and add strong matches to Raven with Track=Wildcard.
